## Explore New York weather

How do temperatures and precipitation change over a year? My
[interactive dashboard](dashboard.html) explores New York weather station records
from 2010 using the NY NOAA dataset in `p8105.datasets`.

Use the line chart to follow monthly temperatures, the bar chart to compare
precipitation, and the scatterplot to explore daily minimum and maximum
temperatures. Hover over a point for details, click a legend to isolate a series,
or drag to zoom.
